The plate is square, about 22–24 cm across. The scrambled egg covers a patch of roughly 9 cm by 8 cm and is about 1.5 cm high. A few small bits sit apart from the main pile. That works out to about 70–80 cm³ of loosely packed egg, and I estimated about 60 g for the main pile. The scattered pieces add about 5 g, so the total is about 65 g.
